character.locked_description: Reyansh is a 10-year-old South Asian boy with a slender build and warm brown skin. His black hair is swept to one side, framing a round face with dark eyes. He wears a navy blue tracksuit top accented with crisp white piping, paired with matching navy trousers and white sneakers. A deep purple hearing aid, colored #5B4B8A, rests securely behind his left ear as a seamless part of his everyday design. A pale lavender #F0EFF4 folded paper fortune-teller peeks out from his tracksuit pocket. At rest, he stands with a balanced, grounded posture, his hands held loosely at his waist, ready to sign with quick, precise movements.
